summary: Coverage of the 24 acceptance criteria and the wave/DAG structure are sound, but slice 02 targets a lead-stage schema (slug column, 4-value kind) that slices 01/03 explicitly do not ship, routes.ts gets two colliding leadsRouter imports across slices 02/03, and the phantom 'converted' stage kind spanning 02/04/06 is only partially repaired by slice 08 (which also cites a board-model.ts/LeadMoveCommand that slice 06 never created).
